additional_info.subject: ID0422801-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117152] Touchscreen issue on the HMI CRM:00315002605
additional_info.body:
Hi Mert,
Thanks for the hint, since it was not added to the timeline I didn't check the attachments.
I checked the video and the screen looks completely frozen.
My idea is to change the DP cable first or check if it's inserted properly and check the result.
If the screen still doesn't work, please check the voltage input to the controller of 24-25V, if we have that, then we can replace the HMI, since we are not able to troubleshoot after the input because of warranty.
Let me know if you need anything else before I send this ticket to the RC-TR queue.
Best regards,
Francisco
